title: Network CSV rerun read-only preview
summary: Added read-only backend modeling for a future Network CSV rerun batch through POST /api/rerun/network-preview. The preview reuses existing CSV rerun classifiers and reports claimable, blocked, skipped, duplicate, source-mapping, output-handoff, and destination-policy evidence without starting workers or writing batch state.
reason: Phase 1 of the Network CSV rerun prework needs a backend-owned, no-mutation model before any start/dry-run or coordinator state work. This keeps worker claims, destination policy, queue mutation, and media movement out of the frontend and out of this phase.
behavior_before: CSV rerun had local preview/start/control routes only. No Local API route modeled network CSV rerun row claims, source mapping readiness, output handoff readiness, or destination policy risk for distributed execution.
behavior_after: POST /api/rerun/network-preview returns desktop_rerun_network_preview.v1 with effect=none, writes_queue=false, writes_network_state=false, touches_media=false, launches_work=false, can_start_network_batch=false, stable proposed row keys, and per-row claim/readiness evidence. No workers are started, no network batch state is written, and no media paths are mutated.
rollback_plan: Remove POST /api/rerun/network-preview from command registries/contracts, remove the read-only network preview helper/facade method, revert the route inventory rows and generated summaries, and remove the Phase 1 tests. No runtime state, queue records, worker claims, pending-publish manifests, or media files are created by this change.
